title: Google review removal rating sensitivity: integer-feasible rounded-score scenarios
kind: Original deterministic mathematical analysis; not observed reviews, a survey or a Canadian business sample
assumptions: Integer ratings from 1 to 5, equally weighted
Nearest-tenth display rounding; exact halves rounded upward (assumed, not confirmed by Google)
Only the specified one-star reviews are removed; all other ratings remain unchanged
Existence of enough one-star reviews is imposed as a feasibility constraint

sources.supports: Google states its review score is the average of all ratings published for a place or business; the exact display-rounding convention is not specified here
Removal eligibility and the review-reporting process
